city_metadata.title: MATERIALS INTELLIGENCE METROPOLIS
city_metadata.subtitle: SCIANCE D1.1: Cartography of AI in European Materials Science
city_metadata.scale_axis_label: Scale Ascension: From Quantum to Industry
city_metadata.scale_axis_description: South-to-North corridor traversing 13 orders of magnitude from Sub-atomic Ångströms to Industrial Gigafactories

districts.name: ATOMISTIC MODELLING & QUANTUM SURROGATES
districts.description: Overcoming the O(N^3) DFT scaling bottleneck using SE(3)/E(3)-equivariant neural potentials, MLIPs, and exascale electronic structure surrogates.

districts.name: GENERATIVE CRYSTAL & INVERSE DESIGN
districts.description: Direct inverse discovery replacing trial-and-error: periodic crystal diffusion models, compositional search, and multi-objective Pareto exploration.

districts.name: DATA-DRIVEN CHARACTERISATION & SYNCHROTRONS
districts.description: High-throughput X-ray diffraction, TEM atomic defect segmentation, and real-time edge AI processing deployed directly at European synchrotron beamlines.

districts.name: AUTONOMOUS DISCOVERY & CLOSED-LOOP LABS
districts.description: Self-Driving Laboratories (SDLs) and Materials Acceleration Platforms (MAPs) running closed-loop Design-Make-Test-Analyze (DMTA) cycles via Bayesian active learning.

districts.name: LAB-TO-FAB & SUSTAINABLE MANUFACTURING
districts.description: Bridging laboratory discoveries to manufacturing: additive manufacturing digital twins, critical raw material substitution, process scale-up tolerances, and circular LCA.

spires.title: NOMAD CoE & Materials Cloud
spires.abstract: European flagship repository hosting 100M+ DFT calculations. Serves as the primary training bedrock for universal interatomic potentials and FAIR data sharing across European supercomputers.

spires.title: CHGNet & Equivariant Potentials
spires.abstract: Pretrained crystal graph neural network incorporating explicit atomic charge states and magnetic moments. Enables microsecond-scale molecular dynamics with quantum-mechanical accuracy.

spires.title: AiiDA Workflow Orchestrator
spires.abstract: Automated interactive infrastructure managing computational graphs with complete cryptographic provenance, coordinating exascale materials simulations across heterogeneous HPC clusters.

spires.title: MatterGen & Crystal Diffusion Core
spires.abstract: Generative diffusion model directly producing periodic 3D crystal structures conditioned on arbitrary property prompts (target bandgap, magnetic ordering, density), breaking the empirical trial-and-error cycle.

spires.title: GNoME Scale Discovery Engine
spires.abstract: Graph Network for Materials Exploration scaling candidate generation to millions of thermodynamically viable inorganic crystals, expanding human knowledge of stable compounds by an order of magnitude.

spires.title: FlowLLM & Chemical NLP Suite
spires.abstract: Domain-adapted large language models extracting structured synthesis recipes, reaction conditions, and phase stability facts directly from millions of scientific papers and patent filings.

spires.title: ESRF Synchrotron Edge AI Pipeline
spires.abstract: In-situ deep learning deployed directly on beamline detectors, executing instantaneous 2D-to-3D diffraction unmixing and real-time phase identification during operando heating experiments.

spires.title: Atomic TEM & APT Defect Vision
spires.abstract: Computer vision pipelines performing sub-pixel atom column tracking, dislocation recognition, and atomic probe tomography (APT) reconstruction with quantified uncertainty.

spires.title: Common Data Model (CDM) Hub
spires.abstract: Harmonized semantic schema aligning spectroscopic, diffraction, and microscopy metadata across European characterisation facilities, ensuring machine-actionable FAIR repositories.

spires.title: A-Lab Autonomous Synthesis Core
spires.abstract: Fully automated solid-state synthesis laboratory combining active learning decision-makers, robotic arms for powder weighing, automated furnace heating, and XRD validation without human intervention.

spires.title: BIG-MAP / Battery 2030+ Hub
spires.abstract: European initiative creating an accelerated discovery platform for next-generation solid-state batteries, integrating multi-scale simulation, automated synthesis, and operando interface tracking.

spires.title: Microfluidic Continuous Flow MAP
spires.abstract: Continuous flow microfluidic platform optimized via multi-objective Bayesian optimization, discovering semiconductor quantum dots and nanoparticles with tight polydispersity control.

spires.title: Additive Manufacturing Digital Twin
spires.abstract: Physics-informed neural operator simulating laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), predicting melt pool porosity, residual stresses, and microstructural evolution in aerospace superalloys.

spires.title: Critical Raw Material Substitute Core
spires.abstract: AI-accelerated compositional screening for permanent magnets and fuel cell catalysts that eliminate reliance on critical raw materials subject to geopolitical supply bottlenecks.

spires.title: Circular LCA & Eco-Design Platform
spires.abstract: Machine learning system embedding carbon footprint, solvent toxicity, and hydrometallurgical recycling yield directly as objective constraints during generative candidate generation.

bottlenecks.title: Dark Data & Negative Reporting Bias
bottlenecks.impact: Literature published over decades records almost exclusively successful syntheses. The omission of negative results systematically warps model priors, producing high false-positive rates during virtual screening.
bottlenecks.remedy: Standardized deposition of failed synthesis logs and negative XRD spectra in NOMAD and AiiDA.

bottlenecks.title: The 'Synthesizability Gap'
bottlenecks.impact: Diffusion and GNN models propose millions of crystals with low energy above the convex hull, but physical labs fail to synthesize them due to insurmountable kinetic barriers or phase separation.
bottlenecks.remedy: Integrating nucleation kinetics and precursor-matching heuristics directly into generative loss functions.

bottlenecks.title: Analytical Rate-Limiter: 232-min GC Latency
bottlenecks.impact: AI Bayesian agents compute the next optimal experiment in 50 milliseconds, but physical characterisation (such as online gas chromatography) takes up to 232 minutes per batch, stalling autonomous loops.
bottlenecks.remedy: Surrogate spectroscopic screening (Raman/UV-Vis) to filter candidates before slow GC confirmation.

bottlenecks.title: Mechatronic Fragility & ~3.9% Robotic Error Rate
bottlenecks.impact: Non-zero hardware exception rates (~3.9%) during solid powder dispensing, pipette clogging, or microfluidic fouling frequently abort unattended 24/7 autonomous exploration campaigns.
bottlenecks.remedy: Computer-vision self-healing routines, automated wash cycles, and robotic grip anomaly detection.

bottlenecks.title: Industrial IP Silos vs Synthetic Academic Data
bottlenecks.impact: Academic AI is trained on pristine idealized DFT simulations, while real-world factory scrap rates, nozzle fouling, and chemical batch variations remain strictly proprietary trade secrets.
bottlenecks.remedy: Federated privacy-preserving machine learning and trusted European data spaces (EOSC/EIT).

challenges.title: EU Critical Raw Materials Act (CRMA)
challenges.target: Achieve strategic technological sovereignty by substituting 100% of imported heavy rare earths and reducing cobalt in EV batteries by 2030.

challenges.title: European Chips Act & Novel Semiconductors
challenges.target: Accelerate discovery of ultra-wide bandgap semiconductors (GaN, SiC, diamond) and 2D dielectric heterostructures for energy-efficient computing.

challenges.title: Grand Scientific Challenge: Multi-Scale Coupling
challenges.target: Seamlessly bridge 10 orders of magnitude in space and 15 in time: from quantum wavefunctions (10^-10 m) to mechanical fatigue of aerospace structures (10^0 m).

challenges.title: Scientific Frontier: Resolving Activity Cliffs
challenges.target: Detect ultra-sensitive non-linear performance jumps where substituting a single dopant atom in a 100-atom supercell dramatically shifts Tc or dielectric breakdown.

challenges.title: Net-Zero Industry Act & Circular Chemistry
challenges.target: Enforce cradle-to-gate carbon intensity and zero-toxic solvent penalties into AI discovery loops before materials reach pilot-line testing.

conduits.name: Quantum Potential Superhighway
conduits.description: High-throughput DFT databases continuously stream energy and force tensors into generative diffusion models to calibrate stable chemical space.

conduits.name: Generative Candidate Dispatch Conduit
conduits.description: Top Pareto-optimal crystal candidates are translated by chemical NLP into executable robotic G-code and liquid handler sequences for A-Lab.

conduits.name: Synchrotron Active Feedback Loop
conduits.description: Real-time XRD phase evolution from synchrotron beamlines updates Gaussian process models in autonomous labs, steering experimental parameters mid-reaction.

conduits.name: Lab-to-Fab Material Transfer Conduit
conduits.description: Laboratory-scale successful alloys are passed to industrial laser powder bed digital twins to simulate manufacturing stresses and scrap rates.

conduits.name: Circular Provenance & AiiDA Registry Ring
conduits.description: Traces computational origin, experimental synthesis conditions, and environmental impact across the entire scale corridor into a circular product passport.
